newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan consortium to develop mobile phone system.
newsitem.headline: Japan consortium to develop mobile phone system.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications said on Tuesday that it plans to form a consortium of telecommunications equipment makers in October to develop a new system for next-generation cellular phones.
The phones will be able to make calls from anywhere in the world and will be also capable of transmitting pictures, it said.
The consortium will try to develop a cellular phone system which will become the worldwide standard.
A ministry official said the consortium's members will include domestic and foreign companies, such as Motorola Inc of the United States and Ericsson of Sweden.
The group will propose its system to the United Nation's International Telecommunication Union, she said. The U.N. body plans to seek proposals for a worldwide standard next year.
